notes.title: Upcoming Update on Dec.24 (Version 1.0.86)
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders,
War of Tanks: Blitzkrieg will have a maintenance on December 24th between 10:30~12:00(GMT+8). Please login after the update is over. The event that was originally scheduled on December 24th 00:00(GMT+8) will be postponed until the end of the update. Please pay close attention to the opening time of the event.

Change log:
1. New Tanks: Light Prismer, Fraudster, War Fortress
2. New Commanders: Natasha, Goodrian
3. Added a Lucky Chest containing the latest tanks and commanders.
4. Adjusted Tanya, Terminator and Desert Storm skills
5. Terminator growth attribute ratio adjusted
6. Carnival event: daily reward on the 3rd day is increased by 50 VIP EXP and 7th day by 70 VIP EXP
